$comment: The shrink-only ratchet for inert light-mode story wrappers (#93, #77).
`<div data-theme="light">` around a story activates NOTHING: @spec-kitty/tokens anchors its
light block on `:root[data-theme="light"], .sk-light`, and `:root` only ever matches <html>.
The story renders the DARK palette on a light background and every gate stays green — axe
included, because the contrast it measures is the dark palette's and that is fine.
TEN, AND THE NUMBER MAY ONLY FALL. #77 migrated grid and section-banner and fixed those two
on the way past; the ten below are the remainder, all in packages/styles. They are #78's and
#79's to retire as those missions convert their components — lower the count in the same
commit that fixes them, which is what makes the improvement a deliberate line in the diff
rather than a silent one.
WHY A COUNT AND NOT A DIRECTORY SCOPE. The first version of this gate scanned
packages/elements/** only, on the theory that each batch mission would widen it. A pass-2
lens showed that model had already failed twice before it was written: sk-stub and
sk-nav-pill are both MIGRATED elements whose styles-layer stories still offend. Migrating a
component does not move its styles-layer story into the elements directory, so a directory
scope keeps missing exactly the files it exists to catch — while
docs/contributing/adding-a-component.md tells authors to fix "the styles-layer story".
WHY A COUNT AND NOT AN ALLOWLIST. Same reason expected-parts.json and .wrapper-floor are
counts: a path list rots on every rename and invites an entry being added rather than a bug
being fixed. A count cannot be added to.

#78 retires feature-card's and ribbon-card's, 10 -> 8. blog-card's does NOT follow in this mission: that component is deferred pending an operator ruling (see #78), so its wrapper is one of the eight that remain.
#79 retires pill-tag's while rewriting its stories onto the generated exports, 8 -> 7. button and check-bullet follow in the same mission.
